# zfb v3 migration guide: zudolab/zudo-doc

Generated 2026-10-04 by an automated diagnosis of `main` @ `337b9f1` (zudo-doc 5.28.2, zfb 2.22.1) and of the pushed migration branch `base/zfb3-migration` @ `d72fea4`. Counts come from the commands listed; re-run them locally before relying on them. This is a **status-and-remaining-path review** of the in-flight epic zudolab/zudo-doc#4430, not a from-scratch plan: zudo-doc is the preset every other zudo-doc host in this diagnosis set waits on.

## Verdict

**Blocked (on the next zfb release), effort L for the remaining path.** 39 of 51 epic topics are merged into the maintainer's *local* `base/zfb3-migration`; the integration floor #4467 is committed clean in a local worktree but BLOCKED on two zfb 3.1.0 bugs (Takazudo/zudo-front-builder#3570 quoted island markers in highlighted code, #3569 Wind extractor UTF-8 panic contained by a temporary serializer shim that is itself a release blocker under DD6). Both are fixed on zfb `main` (3981f6e, merged via #3561 on 2026-10-04) but **unreleased**: `packages/zfb/package.json` on main still says 3.1.0 and 225 commits sit after the `c89d602 chore(release): bump to v3.1.0` commit. Nothing more can be made green until that release ships; the 12 open topics (#4467–#4476, #4482, #4483) are verification, parity, gates and docs, roughly two to three heavy-run days once unblocked. What gates the start today: (1) the next zfb release, (2) the 39 locally merged topics being pushed somewhere other than one machine, (3) the pin and peer floor moving from exact 3.1.0 / `^3.1.0` (#4480) to the release that carries #3569/#3570.

## Sequencing and blockers

1. **Upstream fixes exist but are unreleased (hard gate).** Epic checkpoint 2026-10-02 (#4430, #4467 comment): CI-faithful parity and generated-doc site builds fail on 3.1.0 with `ZR_RAW_HTML` for a display-only `data-zfb-island` string in a highlighted skill code fence (#3570); the #3569 panic is held off by a temporary virtual asset-body ASCII serializer. On zfb main: `94b77a6 fix(zudo-react): decide rawHtml reserved boundaries with a tokenizer pass`, `6fde09f fix(zudo-wind): map extractor offsets from decoded strings to raw UTF-8 source`, `1df6111 test: combined #3569/#3570 regression for quoted island marker with multibyte text` (epic #3619 → PR #3628 → #3561). Watch `npm view @takazudo/zfb dist-tags --json` and the next lane note under https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/changelog/zfb/.
2. **The pin must move again.** #4480 locked exact `3.1.0` / peer floor `^3.1.0`. Once the #3569 shim is removed, a consumer installing 3.1.0 against zudo-doc 6.0.0 would hit the UTF-8 panic on any em dash or Japanese content, so the floor has to be the release that ships #3569/#3570 (#4467 locked spec already says "recheck newest published 3.x and align all pins").
3. **39 merged topics exist only on one machine.** `git ls-remote --heads origin` shows `base/agent-docs-mcp`, `base/zfb3-migration`, `claude/gifted-johnson-w5wuhv`, `main` — no `topic/zfb3-*` branch. The remote `base/zfb3-migration` @ d72fea4 is `main` + 3 commits (73 files, +17,987 lines, all under `_temp-resource/4430-zfb3-migration/`); PR #4477 (draft, `mergeable_state: clean`, 3 commits) shows the same. The local base is at `70e0875` with #4467 at `701c73e` in `worktrees/4467-integration`, ledger `/home/takazudo/.cache/zudo-doc-4430-ledger.json`. **Push the base (and the 4467 topic) now, red CI and all** — the PR body already says "Expect red CI for a while", and a draft PR cannot merge by accident.
4. **Sub-issue state (GitHub, 2026-10-04):** closed 39 = #4431–#4466, #4479, #4480, #4481; open 12 = #4467, #4468, #4469, #4470, #4471, #4472, #4473, #4474, #4475, #4476, #4482, #4483. Order after #4467: #4468 → #4469 → (#4482, #4483 ∥ #4470–#4474) → #4475 → #4476 → owner publishes 6.0.0 and merges #4477 (DD9) → post closure evidence on Takazudo/zudo-front-builder#3328 → zfb docs host re-pin #3329 → identity fixture #3331.
5. **DD8: `check-scaffold-pin-freshness` is red on `main`.** It compares the scaffold pins (2.22.1) and the `^2.22.1` peers against npm `latest` (now 3.1.0) and has no override env var; it gates `publish-create-zudo-doc.yml:190` and `scripts/release-create-zudo-doc.sh:210`. Consequence: **no further 5.x create-zudo-doc release is possible** without weakening the gate (rejected by DD8). If a 5.x hotfix becomes necessary before 6.0.0, that is a decision, not a chore. (Could not re-run it here: the script imports `semver` from `node_modules`; measurement is from the planning map `explore/pkg-build.md` fact 8 and still holds because `latest` only moved further to 3.1.0.)
6. **Upstream Z01–Z26 ledger (label `zudo-doc-v3-dogfood`, 28 issues):** 26 closed, 2 open — #3372 (Z14, catalog proposals: `ring-*`/`animate-*` remain deliberately unsupported even on main) and #3386 (Z26, `group-*`/`peer-*` specificity; the placement half shipped on main as `wind.utilities.placement`). Shipped in **3.1.0** (per https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/changelog/zfb/v3.1.0/): #3364 CSS `exports` subpaths, #3362 nested persisted islands, #3385 `<pre>` LF, #3369 `zfb wind audit --fail-on`, #3389 ZW006 → `authoredClasses` hint, #3390 `<script>`/`<style>` raw-text contract, #3391 typed `on:*` listeners, #3388 project-relative bundle identity, #3392 preview process cleanup, #3366 (partial) excluded-source reporting, plus "Recognize Show and For when consumer and renderer load separate package copies". ## Required changes

Everything below is already implemented in the local base according to the epic checkpoints; it is listed so the owner (and anyone reconstructing from the remote) can verify each item against the file that owns it.

### 1. Dependencies, config, tsconfig, env

- `package.json` (root): the four `@takazudo/zfb*` pins 2.22.1 → next release, drop `preact-render-to-string`; keep `preact` only as zdtp's peer (DD3). `packages/zudo-doc/package.json`: devDeps 3 zfb pins; peers `^2.22.1` → `^<release-with-#3569>`; drop the required `preact` peer; add the `./wind.json` export; remove `./safelist.css` (a Tailwind `@source inline()` file is ZW009 on import) — a breaking export removal that needs a compatibility-matrix row (#4470). `scripts/check-pin-parity.mjs` requires workspace peers to be `^<root pin>` (`workspaceZfbPeerFloorMatches`), so the floor and pin move in one commit with `packages/create-zudo-doc/src/scaffold.ts:985-987`.
- `packages/zudo-doc/src/config.ts:911,913`: `zudoDoc()` is the **only** place `framework: "preact"` and `tailwind: { enabled: true }` are emitted; on v3 either key fails config loading with a named error even inside `presets[]`, and the check runs on the merged preset+user config (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/guides/migrating-to-v3/#configuration). Replace with the package-owned `wind` block (DD4) and a `ZudoDocConfig.wind` passthrough; fix the JSDoc example at `src/preset.ts:373-375`. Same two keys in the 3 fixture configs listed above.
- `packages/zudo-doc/tsconfig.base.json` (shipped to every consumer): `"jsxImportSource": "preact"` → `"@takazudo/zfb/zudo-react"`; delete the `react`/`react/jsx-runtime`/`react-dom` → `preact/compat` `paths` in `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.pages.json`, `templates/base/tsconfig.json`, and the equivalent `resolve.alias` + `server.deps.inline` in `vitest.config.ts`, `vitest.slow.config.ts`, `packages/zudo-doc/vitest.config.ts` (which also scans `node_modules/.pnpm` for `preact-render-to-string`). Why: https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/guides/migrating-to-v3/#components-and-islands.
- `/** @jsxImportSource preact */` pragmas: `git grep -l '@jsxImportSource preact' | wc -l` → 274 tracked files (124 under `__tests__`); a per-file pragma overrides tsconfig and, with `preact` still installed for zdtp, fails static render with `ZR_CHILD` (same doc section). Keep exactly the zdtp-bound files on Preact (`design-token-panel-bootstrap.tsx`, `zdtp-loader.ts`), nothing else.
- No `ZFB_TAILWIND_BIN`/`ZFB_TAILWIND_OXIDE_WARMUP` anywhere → nothing to remove in CI.

### 2. CSS and utilities

- Host-side audit (3.1.0 CLI, `zfb wind audit --project-root /home/user/zudo-doc` with a temporary `wind: { spec: 1 }` config, restored afterwards; scans `pages/` + `src/` only, never `packages/`): `outcome: complete`, `spec: 1 revision 3`; **170 error-severity diagnostics, all ZW006 missing token**, 44 distinct candidates; 163 in `src/components/preset-generator.tsx`, 3 in `src/config/frontmatter-preview-renderers.tsx`, 2 each in `pages/index.tsx` and `pages/[locale]/index.tsx`. Top: `text-small` 20, `gap-x-hsp-xs` 15, `accent-accent` 15, `text-fg` 14, `text-caption` 13, `text-muted` 12, `py-vsp-2xs` 7, `border-muted` 7, `bg-surface` 7, `hover:text-accent` 6, `backdrop:bg-bg/80` 1, `font-bold`/`font-semibold` 1 each. Every one is a zudo-doc semantic token, so they resolve once the preset ships `wind.tokens` (DD4) — these are "tokens to declare", not failures. 0 ZW002/ZW004 errors at class positions: the host uses no responsive or `dark:` variants (`grep -rnoE '\b(sm|md|lg|xl|2xl):[a-z]' src/components src/config pages` → 0). 2 "unrecognized classes" are authored (`zd-preset-gen`, `zd-preset-gen-fallback`). The other 1,945 lines are `auditInfo` noise from non-class string literals in `pages/api/_ai-chat-*.ts`, `src/utils/*.ts` and tests (the standalone plan reads every string literal; see https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/sources-and-candidates/#class-positions-and-confidence).
- Package-side audit (scratch copy of `packages/zudo-doc/src` minus `__tests__`, 379 files, same CLI): with no tokens **1,559 dead classes** (225 distinct; ZW006 1,497, ZW002 62 for `sm:`/`lg:`/`xl:`/`2xl:`, ZW005 14, ZW004 8), 70 unrecognized (authored `zd-*`, `tabs-*`, `math`, `hi-root`, `diff-line-*`, `version-switcher`, `wrap-anywhere`), 19 conflicts. With the planning draft tokens (`explore/artifacts/css-wind/draft-wind-config.json` as `zfb.config.json`) **30 errors remain**, identical to the 3.0.0 planning census: ZW006 ×11 (`rounded-l/r-DEFAULT` ×3 — uppercase `DEFAULT` is invalid, use bare `rounded-l`; `ease-in-out` ×3 needs `easings.in-out`; `shadow-md`, `leading-none`, `max-w-sm`, `rounded-md`, `py-hsp-3xs`), ZW004 ×8 (`[&_a]:…`, `[&_li]:mb-0`, `[&_nav]:mb-0`, `[&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden`, `animate-spin`, `animate-pulse`), ZW005 ×9 (unspaced `calc()` arbitrary values such as `h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem)]` → `h-[calc(100vh_-_3.5rem)]`, one `color-mix()` shadow), ZW002 ×2 (`2xl:w-[24px]` with breakpoints sm/lg/xl). All 30 were the scope of #4435 (merged locally at `46cc2ec`; parity 0 diffs across 65 states). Map: https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/coming-from-tailwind/#variants-and-grammar.
- Directive census (`grep -rnE '@import\s+"tailwindcss|@tailwind|@theme|@apply|@source|@utility|@variant|@custom-variant|@plugin|@config|theme\('` over tracked `*.css|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs`, non-test): 86 lines in 16 files, dominated by comments; the real directives are in `src/styles/global.css` (l.12-15, 64-69, 73), `packages/zudo-doc/src/theme.css` (l.60, 234, 274), `packages/zudo-doc/src/compiled.entry.css` (l.1-9, 11, 17), `packages/create-zudo-doc/templates/base/src/styles/global.css` (l.7-9, 13-17, 20-22, 26), plus the generated `dist/safelist.css`. Each is a ZW009 error even under `wind: false`; one run lists every leftover with `file:line:column` (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/guides/migrating-to-v3/#stylesheets).
- Replacement shape (DD4, re-validated by this audit): package-owned tokens as `var(--…)` pointing at the authored `:root`/`[data-theme]` custom properties (so theme packs and zdtp live tweaks keep working; the zdtp manifest edits 51 `--spacing-*`/`--text-*`/`--leading-*`/`--font-weight-*`/`--radius-*` names), `reset: "owned-v1"` plus the authored preflight patch from https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/coming-from-tailwind/#differences-from-tailwind-preflight, no `spacingUnit`, breakpoints `sm 640 / lg 1024 / xl 1280`, `dark: false` (0 `dark:` uses), `radii.default` instead of `DEFAULT`, `easings["in-out"]`, `manifests: { "zudo-doc": { path: "@takazudo/zudo-doc/wind.json" } }` stamped by `definePreset` so the bare specifier resolves through the package exports (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/api/define-preset/#zudo-wind-manifests-in-presets, https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/configuration/#manifest-path-resolution), `authoredClasses` for the `zd-*`/`text-link`-shaped names that overlap a utility root.
- `scripts/gen-safelist.mjs` → manifest generation. **Next zfb release:** `zfb wind manifest --producer zudo-doc --output dist/wind.json --config <consumer config>` generates and validates it (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/api/cli/#zfb-wind-manifest); on 3.1.0 the manifest must be assembled by the repo's own script (#4440 did this). `scripts/gen-compiled-css.mjs` keeps using `zfb css --input … --source …`; **next zfb release** adds an explicit config file for `zfb css`/`explain`/`audit` (`c3fd330`), which is what a library build without a site project needs (#3368).
- Cascade: utilities are unlayered and placed after authored CSS by default, so the `@layer zd-preflight, zd-flow` trick in `global.css:11` and every `@layer components` rule now lose ties to utilities; DD5 accepted this and fixed flips locally. **Next zfb release:** `wind.utilities.placement: "before-authored"` restores Tailwind's tie order but not the `group-*`/`peer-*` (0,2,0)→(0,1,0) change (#3386 open) — https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/coming-from-tailwind/#utility-placement-and-ties. Decide whether 6.0.0 documents the flip for consumers' own `global.css` rules (#4473).
- `bin/gen-z-index.mjs` must stop emitting a `@theme {}` block (`--no-theme-wrapper` already exists; make it the only mode or emit `wind.tokens.zIndices` JSON — `zIndices` values must be strings, measured in `explore/v3-probe.md` §2c).

### 3. Components and islands

- Census (non-test, `packages/zudo-doc/src` + `src` + `pages`): 346 preact import/pragma lines in 168 files; hooks `useState` 80, `useEffect` 83, `useRef` 50, `useCallback` 32, `useMemo` 19, `createPortal` 3 (`theme-toggle/index.tsx:6,232` only), **no** `useContext`/`createContext`/`forwardRef`/`lazy`/`Suspense`/`useId`; `className=` 361, `onClick=` 57, `onChange=` 27, `onKeyDown=` 5, `onInput=` 1; `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` 57 lines (38 JSX sites per planning), 17 of them on `<script>`/`<style>` → `rawHtml={…}` (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-react/coming-from-preact-hooks/#trusted-raw-html); `xmlns=` 43, `property=` 9, `popover` 8, `<iframe` 2 (`html-preview-wrapper/preview-base.tsx`), `<select` 5 (none `multiple`), 0 `type="file|range|number|date"`, 0 contenteditable → every form control has a supported model (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-react/forms/).
- Ports (all merged locally): shared primitives first (#4441: `use-modal-dialog` → `modalDialog(scope, options)`, `island-types`, Icons, `tree-nav-shared`, `hydration-pending`), persisted-chrome helpers (#4442: `transitions/nested-island-props-refresh.ts` against v3 wrapper metadata; #3362 native since 3.1.0), 12 nav/chrome islands (#4443–#4449, #4462), 8 content islands (#4450–#4456), SSR layer (#4457–#4461), composition/routes/host (#4464–#4466). ThemeToggle's portal becomes an in-tree `<dialog>`/popover (#4446; `popover` attribute needs the **next zfb release**, #3359).
- Island contract items to re-verify on the new release: identity = function name (23 `displayName` pins all equal the name — harmless), JSON-strict props (undefined members are omitted since #3376; arrays stay strict), fail-closed hydration, no nested islands, `<Island>` has no persist prop so persisted roots stay hand-authored wrappers with full metadata (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/concepts/islands/, https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-react/server-rendering/). `ClientRouterBootstrap` (`src/components/client-router-bootstrap.tsx`) may be deletable if the scanner ships the router from the package closure — verify, per `explore/islands-nav.md` §1.5.
- zdtp (DD3): stays an opaque, lazily imported Preact bundle mounted from a zudo-react island, exactly the pattern in https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/concepts/islands/#embedding-a-third-party-widget; measured working on 3.0.0 (`explore/deps-docs.md` A0.2). `preact` remains only as zdtp's peer; Takazudo/zudo-design-token-panel#1002 asks zdtp to bundle Preact so the peer can disappear later.
- Runtime identity: the package imports `@takazudo/zfb/zudo-react`; consumers must resolve **one** copy (peer, never a dependency; test packed tarballs via `pnpm pack` + `file:`, never `link:` — lessons digest §5). 3.1.0 already patched one duplicate-copy symptom (Show/For recognition); #3331 is the upstream fixture that will prove it for published presets.

### 4. md-wasm and other packages

- `@takazudo/zfb-md-wasm`: only `/parse`, `/render`, `/highlight` are imported; `git grep -nE "jsxRuntime\s*:"` → 0. Version bump only (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/api/md-wasm/). The 4 `.wasm` digests change every release; no digest is pinned in this repo.
- `@takazudo/zfb-adapter-cloudflare`: exports unchanged; `worker-entry.ts` keeps importing `./dist/_worker.js`. **Next zfb release** strips the dangling `//# sourceMappingURL=bundle-runtime.mjs.map` from `_zfb_inner.mjs` (#3480), which removes the Vite ENOENT warning `vitest.worker.config.ts` (`@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`) would otherwise log.
- `@takazudo/zfb-runtime`: 2 import sites (`doclayout/doc-layout.tsx`, `client-router-bootstrap.tsx`); the removed `framework` adapter and `createPageRouter({ framework })` are not used. `preserveHtmlAttrs` for `data-theme`/`data-sidebar-hidden` stays.
- `create-zudo-doc` (#4463 merged locally, 772 generator tests): v3 template `global.css` (no Tailwind imports, no `@source`, no `@theme`), tsconfig without react paths, `claude-md-gen.ts` text, `scaffold.ts` pins/peers (drop `preact-render-to-string`; keep `preact` only when `designTokenPanel` is on).
- `doc-history-server`, `search-worker`: no change.

### 5. Tests, CI, deploy

- Tests: 126 unit files are Preact-coupled (`explore/tests-ci.md`): 80 `preact-render-to-string` SSR-string suites → `renderToString` from `@takazudo/zfb/zudo-react/server`; 30 VNode-walker suites → rewrite (descriptions are inert, no introspection); 10 happy-dom `render()`+`act()` suites → `hydrate`/`mount` + `flush()` harness (#4438; https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-react/testing/); 3 hook tests → signal/scope module tests. The 38 A2 sha256 hashes in `route-injection-build.slow.test.ts` are the one permitted red set until #4470 re-baselines them (3 mismatches recorded at #4467).
- Gates: `check:package-safelist` → manifest coverage check (#4440 "lockstep safelist-gate rename"); add `pnpm exec zfb wind audit --project-root . --fail-on error` (3.1.0; https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/diagnostics-and-tools/#explain-and-audit) — **next zfb release** adds `--json`, `--severity`, `wind.strict` so ZW014 "no silent utilities" (acceptance bullet 2 of #4430) can fail the build; `check-scaffold-pin-freshness` turns green only when the scaffold pins 3.x; `check-pin-parity` enforces the atomic bump.
- CI (`pr-checks.yml`, Node 22 from `.nvmrc`, pnpm 10.30.3): no Tailwind/Preact-specific steps; the E2E job (Playwright container) and Build Site consume the linux-x64 binary from `optionalDependencies`. Deploy (`main-deploy.yml`) is unchanged except that `_zfb_inner.mjs` bytes become path-independent (#3388, 3.1.0). Expect `islands-*.js` to grow about 2.2× vs Preact (#3383, closed not_planned) — record it in parity, do not block on it.
- Toolchain caution for the **next zfb release**: zfb's own repo moved to TypeScript 7.0.2, pnpm 12.8.2, Vitest 4.1.11 and Oxfmt in the same merge (#3629). zudo-doc pins `typescript ^5.9.3`; re-run `pnpm check`, `check:pages`, `check:e2e`, `check:worker` against the published `.d.ts` before trusting the bump.

## Step-by-step plan

The official 7-step checklist (https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/guides/migrating-to-v3/#checklist) is already executed in the local base; what follows is the **resume path**.

1. **Today, before anything else:** from the main checkout (the worktree pre-push hook blocks worktree pushes), `git push origin base/zfb3-migration` (local `70e0875`) and `git push origin topic/zfb3-4467-integration` (`701c73e`); push the other `topic/zfb3-*` branches or tag them. Add a checkpoint comment on #4430 naming the pushed SHAs. Also commit the ledger's content (or its path) into `docs/findings/4430-zfb3-migration/README.md`.
2. **Watch for the release:** `npm view @takazudo/zfb dist-tags --json` and read `docs/src/content/docs/changelog/zfb/v3.*.mdx` on zfb main; confirm #3569, #3570, #3359, #3361, #3368, #3370, #3371 are in the published tarball (`pnpm pack`, inspect `dist/zudo-react/render-html.js` attribute table and `zfb wind manifest --help`).
3. **Resume #4467 on the release** (heavy runs through `bash $HOME/.claude/scripts/heavy-guard.sh -- <cmd>`): bump all pins atomically (`package.json` ×4, `packages/zudo-doc/package.json` devDeps ×3 + peers, `packages/create-zudo-doc/src/scaffold.ts:985-987`, fixtures), `pnpm install`, `pnpm build:workspace`; delete the #3569 serializer shim, the #3359 head/attribute serializer, the #3361 iframe shim; keep #3375 style fallbacks only where the published validator still rejects; regenerate `dist/wind.json` (with `zfb wind manifest` once available) and `dist/compiled.css`; run `pnpm check`, `pnpm check:pages`, `pnpm check:e2e`, `pnpm check:worker`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:unit:slow`, `scripts/parity-build.sh`, a local `pnpm build` with the gitignored `.claude`/`.codex` generated docs present, `pnpm exec zfb wind audit --project-root . --fail-on error`, `bash e2e/setup-fixtures.sh` (6 fixtures). Append the command/exit/duration table to `docs/findings/4430-zfb3-migration/README.md`.
4. **#4468 → #4469:** parity against the sealed v2 baseline (#4431 harness: 789 pages, 65 browser states, hydration-health probe incl. after client-side navigation, 6-fixture e2e, view-transition gates, non-root `base` build, `zfb dev`, Worker contract); triage every non-noise diff as local or upstream; file upstream with the `zudo-doc-v3-dogfood` label.
5. **#4482, #4483** (intentional fixes) in parallel with **#4470–#4474**: gates re-baseline (A2 hashes, compatibility matrix incl. the `./safelist.css` export removal, prepack contract, token lint, TESTING.md's happy-dom drift), EN+JA docs rewrite, **#4473 consumer guide** `src/content/docs/guides/migrating-to-zudo-doc-6.mdx` + JA mirror + `packages/zudo-doc/README.md`.
6. **#4475** final confirm: `pnpm b4push`, packed scaffolds built **and hydrated and interacted with**, Worker contract, v3-vs-production check; verdict PASS or BLOCKED. A BLOCKED verdict stops #4476's `_temp-resource` deletion and the root merge.
7. **#4476 → release:** dogfood report, finalized `docs/findings/4430-zfb3-migration/`, delete `_temp-resource/4430-zfb3-migration/`, mark #4477 ready, owner publishes the lockstep 6.0.0 (history-server, zudo-doc, create-zudo-doc; `RELEASE.md` floor rule: peers raised to `^6.0.0` only in the release commit) and merges #4477 the same day (DD9); post exact versions, binary version, "no shim remains", export/MDX/CSS checks, production hydration results and the gap-table link on Takazudo/zudo-front-builder#3328; then #3329 (zfb docs host re-pin) and #3331.

## Verification checklist

- [ ] Remote `base/zfb3-migration` head equals the local base; every merged topic SHA from the #4430 checkpoints is reachable from origin.
- [ ] `node_modules/@takazudo/zfb/package.json` version = the release carrying #3569/#3570; `pnpm exec zfb --version` prints that version and `embedded esbuild` with no Tailwind line.
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'framework:|tailwind:' packages/zudo-doc/src/config.ts packages/zudo-doc/src/__tests__/fixtures` → 0 emitted keys; `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] `git grep -l '@jsxImportSource preact'` lists only zdtp-bound files; `git grep -lE "from ['\"]preact" -- ':!**/__tests__/**'` likewise.
- [ ] `pnpm exec zfb wind audit --project-root . --fail-on error` exits 0; the `unrecognized classes` section contains only intentionally authored names, each present in `wind.authoredClasses` or styled in authored CSS.
- [ ] No ZW009 on `pnpm build`; `src/styles/global.css`, `compiled.entry.css`, the template `global.css` carry no Tailwind import/directive.
- [ ] `dist/wind.json` validates (`schemaVersion: 1`, `specVersion: 1`, `producer: "zudo-doc"`); the packed tarball exports `./wind.json`, `./theme.css`, `./content.css`, `./features.css`, `./page-loading.css`, `./compiled.css` and **not** `./safelist.css`.
- [ ] Browser: all 19 island components hydrate on `/`, a docs page, a versioned page and a `ja/` page, before and after a client-side navigation; persisted header/sidebar/footer islands do not remount (`el === elAfterNav`); theme toggle, theme-pack dialog, search, AI chat (with Japanese IME, #3330), doc history, image/mermaid enlarge, HtmlPreview iframe work.
- [ ] Computed-style parity vs the v2 baseline across the 65 captured states, including `sub`/`sup`, `::placeholder`, `::file-selector-button`, `[hidden]`, `code`/`pre` font stacks.
- [ ] `pnpm test:worker` / `verify:worker-contract` green; `dist/_zfb_inner.mjs` has no dangling source-map trailer.
- [ ] `node scripts/check-scaffold-pin-freshness.mjs` and `node scripts/check-pin-parity.mjs` green; a fresh `npm create zudo-doc@<6.0.0>` scaffold builds, hydrates and passes its own `pnpm check`.
- [ ] `docs/findings/4430-zfb3-migration/` has a row per topic, every deviation named, zero remaining shims.

## Risks and open questions

- **Single-machine state.** 39 topics plus the integration worktree exist only locally; a disk or worktree accident loses two weeks of ports. Mitigation is step 1 above.
- **Release timing and floor.** If the next zfb release is 3.1.x the `^3.1.0` floor stays numerically valid but semantically wrong (3.1.0 panics on UTF-8 offsets once the shim is gone); raise it to the exact release regardless of its number.
- **Still-open upstream:** #3372 (`ring-*`, `animate-*` remain unsupported → authored CSS for `animate-spin`/`animate-pulse` is permanent), #3386 (relation-variant specificity; decide placement for 6.0.0), #3330 (real Japanese IME on `modelValue` inputs — AI chat and search), #3127 (plugin-host 120 s init timeout; zudo-doc ships 12 plugins), #3331 (identity fixture; zudo-doc's release unblocks it).
- **Cascade flip for consumers.** Consumers' own `global.css` rules used to beat utilities on ties (Tailwind imported first); under `after-authored` they lose. Either ship `utilities.placement: "before-authored"` in the preset once the release ships, or document the flip in #4473 with the three per-rule remedies from https://zfb.takazudomodular.com/zudo-wind/coming-from-tailwind/#relation-variant-specificity.
- **Toolchain drift in the release** (TS 7 declaration output, pnpm 12) vs zudo-doc's TS ^5.9.3 / pnpm 10.30.3: verify types before the bump commit.
- **5.x is frozen by a red gate**, not by policy alone; a security hotfix on 5.x would need an explicit DD8 revisit.
- **Island bundle size** ~2.2× (#3383): not a blocker, but the showcase advertises small islands — record the measured delta in parity.
- **Agent Docs MCP base** (`base/agent-docs-mcp`, #4486–#4497 closed): confirm whether it is stacked on `#4477`'s base and in which order the two land on `main`.
